process_area.title: Armored Car, Vault & Cash Logistics Execution

fields.Participants: CIT Ops Mgr, Procurement, Security/LP, Legal, Treasury
fields.Trigger: RFP, contract renewal, or new region expansion
fields.Volume: 2–3 CIT partners (e.g., ARMSCOR, LBC, private armored fleets)

workflows.name: Armored Car Partner Onboarding, Vetting & Contract Management

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-validate of "checks, armored vehicle specifications" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-review of "reviews liability/indemnity clauses" (replaces manual Step 2).
Controls: - CTL-473 (ensure controlled execution — Armored Car, Vault & Cash Logistics Execution (PA-81.2).)
- operational: SOSIA/BSP license validation and reference checks
Pain Points / Risks: - **Security risk**: Under-vetted partner creates robbery/fraud exposure; mitigated by SOSIA/BSP license validation and reference checks
System Touchpoints: - Vendor master; CIT operations system; contract repository

steps.activity: Security/LP vets CIT partner: PNP SOSIA license, BSP registration, insurance coverage (cash-in-transit), employee background checks, armored vehicle specifications
Procurement leads RFP and commercial negotiation (per-pickup fee, route pricing, change-order fee, SLA); Legal reviews liability/indemnity clauses
Treasury/Payment Ops executes contract; configures partner in CIT operations system; pilots one region before nationwide rollout

fields.Participants: Store Manager, CIT Guard, CIT Operations

workflows.name: Pickup Execution, Guard Verification & Handover Protocol

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-route of "route manifest, photo match, pre-shared" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-validate of "verify sealed-bag IDs against manifest" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-update of "CIT Operations confirms pickup completion in system" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - operational: multi-factor guard verification (ID + photo + code)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Security risk**: Impersonation robbery; mitigated by multi-factor guard verification (ID + photo + code)
System Touchpoints: - Guard verification app; custody-transfer manifest; LP exception monitor

steps.activity: Store Manager verifies armored guard identity (ID, route manifest, photo match, pre-shared code) before opening; denies access on mismatch
Store Manager and guard execute two-man handover; count/verify sealed-bag IDs against manifest; both sign custody transfer receipt
CIT Operations confirms pickup completion in system; store cash-office system updates custody status; LP flags any unconfirmed handover for investigation

workflows.name: In-Transit Custody Chain, GPS Telematics & Route Monitoring

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-route of "route adherence to CIT Operations dashboard" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-monitor of "monitors route ETA, geofenced stops, and vehicle stoppage" (replaces manual Step 2).
Pain Points / Risks: - **Security risk**: Unmonitored transit invites heist; mitigated by real-time GPS and geofencing
System Touchpoints: - GPS telematics feed; route-monitoring dashboard; custody-chain ledger

steps.activity: CIT vendor's armored vehicles transmit GPS location and route adherence to CIT Operations dashboard; deviation triggers alert
CIT Operations monitors route ETA, geofenced stops, and vehicle stoppage; investigates unplanned stops or off-route deviation in real time
LP correlates in-transit data with incident history; maintains custody chain evidence (timestamp, location, guard ID) for each deposit

fields.Participants: Vault Ops, CIT Operations, Finance, LP

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "logs custody transfer" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-count of "counts via currency counter with counterfeit detection" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-review of "reviews variance trend by store for shrink indicators" (replaces manual Step 3).
Pain Points / Risks: - **Loss risk**: Counting errors and shrink; mitigated by dual-control and currency counters
System Touchpoints: - Vault management module; currency counters; GL posting; variance analytics

steps.activity: Vault Ops receives sealed deposit bags under dual-control; logs custody transfer; schedules counting by denomination
Vault Ops counts via currency counter with counterfeit detection; reconciles to store-reported amount; investigates variances > PHP 1,000
Finance posts vault cash to GL; prepares bank deposit; LP reviews variance trend by store for shrink indicators

workflows.name: Bank Deposit Posting, Clearance & Difference Resolution

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-count of "hands over consolidated deposit to bank under manifest" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-reconcile of "reconciles bank-credited amount to vault-reported amount" (replaces manual Step 2).
Controls: - CTL-473 (ensure controlled execution — Armored Car, Vault & Cash Logistics Execution (PA-81.2).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Reconciliation risk**: Bank-vs-vault differences indicate shrink/counterfeit; mitigated by same-day reconciliation
System Touchpoints: - Bank deposit receipt; GL clearing; treasury bank-statement import

steps.activity: Vault Ops hands over consolidated deposit to bank under manifest; bank issues deposit receipt with counted amount
Finance posts deposit receipt to GL; reconciles bank-credited amount to vault-reported amount; investigates any bank adjustment (counterfeit, mutilated)
Treasury confirms bank credit reflected in account; clears cash-in-transit GL; resolves timing differences within 1–2 business days

fields.Participants: CIT Ops Mgr, LP, Security, Legal, PNP, Insurance, BCM
fields.Trigger: Robbery attempt, accident, or service disruption

workflows.name: CIT Service Disruption, Robbery & Emergency Response

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-alert of "CIT vendor activates emergency protocol" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-file of "files insurance claim for CIT-insured loss" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-473 (ensure controlled execution — Armored Car, Vault & Cash Logistics Execution (PA-81.2).)
- operational: insured CIT and rehearsed emergency protocol
Pain Points / Risks: - **Loss/security risk**: Robbery causes cash loss and staff trauma; mitigated by insured CIT and rehearsed emergency protocol
System Touchpoints: - Emergency alert integration; LP case management; insurance claims module
Time Estimate: - Hours to weeks depending on severity

steps.activity: CIT vendor activates emergency protocol (panic button, GPS alert); coordinates with PNP; LP notifies CIT Operations Manager immediately
LP preserves evidence (CCTV, telematics, witness statements); liaises with PNP for investigation; secures alternative pickup for affected stores
Legal/Insurance files insurance claim for CIT-insured loss; Legal pursues vendor liability per contract; BCM updates risk register and reroutes services

fields.Trigger: Imbalance in change-fund demand across stores

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-monitor of "monitors cash surplus/deficit by store" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-distribute of "redistributes cash between stores via armored car" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-validate of "validates net cash position unaffected" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-473 (ensure controlled execution — Armored Car, Vault & Cash Logistics Execution (PA-81.2).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Cost risk**: Bank-only change sourcing incurs fees; mitigated by inter-store recirculation
System Touchpoints: - Store cash-position monitor; cross-store transfer orders; treasury GL

steps.activity: CIT Operations monitors cash surplus/deficit by store; identifies stores with chronic coin shortage vs. note surplus
CIT Operations redistributes cash between stores via armored car (cross-store transfer) instead of bank withdrawal/deposit; reduces cost
Treasury validates net cash position unaffected; updates store float GL; reports recirculation savings to Finance

fields.Participants: CIT Ops Mgr, Procurement, Finance, LP

workflows.name: CIT Vendor Performance, SLA & Cost Management

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-track of "CIT Operations tracks KPIs" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-review of "reviews SLA compliance, credits for service failures, and contract renewals" (replaces manual Step 2).
Controls: - CTL-473 (ensure controlled execution — Armored Car, Vault & Cash Logistics Execution (PA-81.2).)
- operational: SLA credits and competitive benchmarking
Pain Points / Risks: - **Cost/service risk**: Vendor underperformance raises risk and cost; mitigated by SLA credits and competitive benchmarking
System Touchpoints: - CIT KPI dashboard; QBR repository; vendor scorecard

steps.activity: CIT Operations tracks KPIs: on-time pickup %, custody discrepancies, robbery/loss incidents, change-order fulfillment, cost per pickup
Procurement/LP conducts QBR with vendor; reviews SLA compliance, credits for service failures, and contract renewals
Finance benchmarks CIT cost vs. cash-handling cost reduction; recommends vendor mix optimization and contract renegotiation
